schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE ACTIVITY (
    PLAYER_ID INT,
    EVENT_DATE DATE,
    DEVICE_ID INT,
    GAMES_PLAYED INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (PLAYER_ID, EVENT_DATE),
    CHECK (GAMES_PLAYED >= 0)
);
q1: SELECT A1.FIRST_LOGIN AS INSTALL_DT, COUNT(DISTINCT A1.PLAYER_ID) AS INSTALLS, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN (A1.FIRST_LOGIN + 1) = A2.EVENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/ COUNT(DISTINCT A1.PLAYER_ID)), 2) AS DAY1_RETENTION FROM (SELECT PLAYER_ID, MIN(EVENT_DATE) AS FIRST_LOGIN FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY PLAYER_ID) AS A1 JOIN ACTIVITY AS A2 ON A1.PLAYER_ID = A2.PLAYER_ID GROUP BY A1.FIRST_LOGIN
q2: SELECT FISRT_DATE AS INSTALL_DT, COUNT(DISTINCT A.PLAYER_ID) AS INSTALLS, ROUND(COUNT(EVENT_DATE)/COUNT(DISTINCT A.PLAYER_ID),2) AS DAY1_RETENTION FROM ( SELECT PLAYER_ID, MIN(EVENT_DATE) AS FISRT_DATE FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY PLAYER_ID ) A LEFT JOIN ACTIVITY B ON A.FISRT_DATE = B.EVENT_DATE - 1 AND A.PLAYER_ID = B.PLAYER_ID GROUP BY INSTALL_DT

q2_prompt_sql: SELECT FISRT_DATE AS INSTALL_DT, COUNT(DISTINCT A.PLAYER_ID) AS INSTALLS, ROUND(COUNT(EVENT_DATE)/COUNT(DISTINCT A.PLAYER_ID),2) AS DAY1_RETENTION FROM ( SELECT PLAYER_ID, MIN(EVENT_DATE) AS FISRT_DATE FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY PLAYER_ID ) A LEFT JOIN ACTIVITY B ON A.FISRT_DATE = B.EVENT_DATE - 1 AND A.PLAYER_ID = B.PLAYER_ID GROUP BY INSTALL_DT
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent because Q1 calculates the day-1 retention rate by dividing the count of players who made an event on the day after their first login by the total number of distinct players. On the other hand, Q2 calculates the day-1 retention rate by dividing the total count of events on the day after the first login by the total number of distinct players.
counterexample_dsp: The difference between Q1 and Q2 can be observed when a player has multiple events on the day after their first login. Q1 will count each of these events as a separate retention, while Q2 will count the player only once.
